description: §19.16.2 (S430 round 5, F3/F4) — a bare `{ }` block and a single-statement (unbraced) `match` arm are not stage-1 defer sites: each is E-DEFER-UNSUPPORTED-SITE (two occurrences), never an unexplained E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC and never a defer silently attached to the enclosing block.
rationale: §19.16.2: a bare block and an unbraced match / handler arm are carried as text, so a `defer` there has no block to attach to; it SHALL be a compile error.
